## Privacy notice

Do not upload or paste face images, camera frames, screenshots containing
faces, embeddings, landmarks, profile/vault files, KWallet keys, similarity
scores, stable camera identifiers, biometric paths, personal data, or
unredacted support reports. Reports containing this material will be removed.
Use a synthetic frame, fake worker mode, aggregate status, and a redacted
report instead.
